verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MWOYO gwange,wulira,
Yesu Mulokozi wo;
Akubuuza ggwe bw'ati:
Mwana wange-onjagala?

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Nnyina ki-atajjukira
Bulijjo omwana we?
Ye yeerabira-omwana:
Naye siirekenga ggwe.

verse.name: v4
v5
v6
verse.lines:
Mulokozi,gunsinze;
Nnali nga sikwagala:
Naye leero mpa ekisa,
Nnyongere kukwagala.
